title: A two-photon FRAP protocol to measure the stereociliary membrane diffusivity in rat cochlear hair cells
protocol: Turn on the two-photon acquisition system.
Tune the laser to 860 nm.
Test the laser power for Pphotobleaching and Pimaging.
Set Pockels cell values for Pphotobleaching and Pimaging.
Confirm laser power reading on the power meter.
Align the optics to focus on a chroma slide.
Test the Mark Point functionality to perform point bleaching.
Measure 25 mL of 10× extracellular stock solution.
Add measured stock solution to a 250 mL beaker with 200 mL milli-Q H2O.
Add 74.5 mg creatine monohydrate, 270 mg glucose, and 0.5 mL of 1M/1M pyruvate/ascorbate to the solution.
Adjust pH to 7.4 with 1M NaOH.
Raise volume of solution to 250 mL using milli-Q H2O in a volumetric flask.
Check osmolality of the solution.
Raise osmolality to 304–307 if needed, by adding NaCl.
Prepare working dye solution of di-3-ANEPPDHQ.
Thaw a vial of 2 μl aliquot of 30 mM di-3-ANEPPDHQ stock solution.
Add 1 mL extracellular solution to the stock to make a di-3-ANEPPDHQ concentration of 60 μM.
Pipette 100 μl of the 60 μM solution and transfer it to a 1 mL vial.
Add 900 μl of extracellular solution to the vial and vortex it.
This results in a final di-3-ANEPPDHQ concentration of 6 μM.
Store the remaining 60 μM stock solution in the freezer at −20°C for up to 3 months.
Dissect the apical turn of isolated organ of Corti from Sprague Dawley rat pups at postnatal day 8 (P8) to P9, regardless of sex.
Incubate the dissected tissue in a 6 μM di-3-ANEPPDHQ working solution for 5 minutes at room temperature while protecting it from light.
Transfer the tissue into the recording chamber with dye-free extracellular solution.
Place the tissue above the angled cover slip so that the stria vascularis is at the top and the organ of Corti is at the bottom.
Place the top dental floss on the stria vascularis and the bottom dental floss near the epithelial ridge area, ideally close to the IHC row.
Pull the bottom dental floss even lower to stretch the tissue.
Ensure that the IHC bundles are oriented vertically.
Position the recording chamber with the mounted tissue under the microscope.
Align the optics and focus the tissue using a 100× objective lens.
Pick the hair bundle to image in standard bright field illumination mode.
Set the Ultima system to operate as a laser scanner system.
Adjust the Pockels cell control value corresponding to imaging conditions.
Set the GaAsP PMT gain to 800 V.
Focus just above the tip of the IHC bundle in live scan mode.
Move down along the bundle tip using remote focus control.
Pick a focal plane where fluorescence intensity of stereocilia is at least 3 times that of the background.
Select a small image frame incorporating the ROI for FRAP.
Set up a pre-bleach cycle with duration of 5 seconds and frame rate of 1 fps.
Photobleach for 100 ms using the Mark Point functionality.
Set up a post-bleach cycle with duration of 1 second and frame rate of 5 fps.
Set up another post-bleach cycle with duration of 11 seconds and frame rate of 1 fps.
Mark a point at the tip of the stereocilia to be bleached.
Adjust Pockels cell control value corresponding to photobleaching laser power.
Ensure Pockels cell control value on main window is set to imaging power.
Run the T-series.
Use appropriate laser safety warning signs before and during the two-photon FRAP experiment.
Indicate that a Class 4 laser system is in use with signage throughout the experiment.
Perform the experiment in a light-controlled environment to protect sensitive equipment from excessive light exposure.
Import all images from one FRAP sequence using ImageJ.
Select the first image in the sequence for import.
Enter the number of images in the sequence and confirm import by clicking OK.
Run the StackReg Plugin in ImageJ to align images if motion artifacts are present.
Mark ROIs for measuring average fluorescence intensity: bleached region (BL), reference region (REF), and background region (BK).
Measure the average fluorescence intensity within the bleached spot (I_B_L).
Measure the average fluorescence intensity of the reference region (I_REF).
Measure the average fluorescence intensity of the background region (I_BK).
Generate a FRAP curve with normalized fluorescence intensity on the y-axis and time on the x-axis.
Subtract I B K from I B L and I R E F .
Normalize background-subtracted intensity values at each time point to the pre-bleached intensity averaged from the first 5 images preceding photobleaching, setting average pre-bleach intensity to 1.
Normalize normalized intensity from bleached ROI (I B L norm) to intensity from reference ROI (I REF norm) at each time point to generate FRAP curve.
Confirm that photobleaching of di-3-ANEPPDHQ is irreversible.
Aliquot 0.1 mL of 10 mg/mL pure DOPC in chloroform to a glass vial.
Evaporate the lipid stock solution by vacuum for 30 min to leave a dried lipid film.
Hydrate the dried lipids in 0.25 mL of 100 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4 for an hour.
Extrude the solution using the Mini extruder through a 200 nm polycarbonate membrane 11 times.
Add 41.6 μL of 60 μM di-3-ANEPPDHQ stock to the lipid solution to make [dye: lipid] ratio of 1:1000.
Keep the lipid dye solution at 4°C, protected from light.
Mount DOPC vesicles on a slide in 0.5% agarose gel at a 1:1 ratio to maintain mechanical stability.
Tune the laser to 860 nm and align optics to focus within the vesicles.
Select a vesicle of size < 0.5 μm for complete bleaching.
Run FRAP protocol sequences including prebleach, bleach, and postbleach cycles using established parameters.
Analyze FRAP data using Image J to generate an FRAP curve.
Determine parameters for the FRAP diffusion model based on IHC stereocilia FRAP curves.
Calculate the diffusion coefficient D from the FRAP curve using Mathematica.
Mount a 250 μm Z-axis Piezo Drive on the microscope.
Dissect and mount the organ of Corti incubated in 6 μM di-3-ANEPPDHQ for 5 minutes.
Select the ROI at the tip of one stereocilium.
Bleach the tip with the bleaching parameters determined previously.
Take a fast z-stack image series with step size of 0.5 μm after bleaching.
Measure the degree of bleaching at each z-plane.
Normalize the degree of bleaching at each z-plane to that at the plane of bleaching, i.e., the stereocilium tip.
Plot the normalized degree of bleaching against the position along the z-axis relative to the bleach spot.
Use Gaussian fitting to measure the effective axial extent of bleaching.
Incubate the organ of Corti tissue in 6 μM di-3-ANEPPDHQ and mount it in a recording chamber so that the stereocilia stand up.
Take live-cell z-stack images of the hair bundle using a high-resolution microscope.
Create a 3D reconstruction of the hair bundle to measure the length of the stereocilia.
